title: Inspect and extend: Likes and saved posts
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/feed.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve likemap, bookmarkmap, toggles, and the saved-post projection.
problem: A like or bookmark is a personal switch keyed by post ID. Trace each button into its toggle function, then inspect how bookmarkedPosts resolves IDs back into feed records while keeping feed order. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/feed.ts` and the related project files: src/screens/FeedScreen.tsx; src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx; src/feed.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to likemap, bookmarkmap, toggles, and the saved-post projection.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Bookmarks and likes are per-device demo state, not synced account records.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A like or bookmark is a personal switch keyed by post ID. Trace each button into its toggle function, then inspect how bookmarkedPosts resolves IDs back into feed records while keeping feed order.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/feed.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
